mapper.sql: id, project_id, type, name, description, category, builtin, config_schema, class_name, raw_json, del_flag, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yglue_flow_resolver (project_id, type, name, description, category, builtin, config_schema, class_name, raw_json, del_flag) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{type}, #{name}, #{description}, #{category}, #{builtin}, #{configSchema}, #{className}, #{rawJson}, #{delFlag})
mapper.update: UPDATE yglue_flow_resolver SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, builtin = #{builtin}, config_schema = #{configSchema}, class_name = #{className}, raw_json = #{rawJson}, del_flag = #{delFlag}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM yglue_flow_resolver WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY builtin DESC, name ASC
